tools.name: search_ingredients
tools.title: Search ingredients
tools.description: Search Skingredient's ingredient dictionary by name, alias, benefit, or caution keyword. Returns a compact list with id, name, category, caution level, and primary benefits.

query.description: Keyword to match against ingredient name, aliases, benefits, or supports.

tools.name: get_ingredient
tools.title: Get ingredient details
tools.description: Return the full dictionary entry for a Skingredient ingredient by id or name, including aliases, primary benefits, caution level, and safety notes.

idOrName.description: Ingredient id (e.g. 'retinol') or display name / alias (e.g. 'Vitamin B3').

tools.name: list_products
tools.title: List sample products
tools.description: List Skingredient's sample product catalog with brand, category, key ingredients, and benefit tags. Optionally filter by category or key-ingredient keyword.

ingredient.description: Filter to products containing this key ingredient.

tools.name: get_recommendation
tools.title: Get a daily skin recommendation
tools.description: Run Skingredient's deterministic recommendation engine for a given skin analysis and context. Returns the recommended direction (e.g. barrier-recovery), prioritized ingredients, and ingredients to avoid today.

redness.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

hydration.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

acne.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

oiliness.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

texture.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

pores.description: 0-100 score from the daily skin analysis.

sensitivities.description: Known sensitivities to filter from prioritized ingredients.

eventTiming.description: Timing of any upcoming event that should influence today's plan.
